rv.q: Lost in Del Valle stands as a testament to the capacities of solo theatre at its most exacting.
This U.S. premiere is as unflinching as it is mesmerizing—an unforgettable descent into the chaos of a life lived on the edge.

cn.t: Van Zandt delivers a blistering one-man performance in this dark comedy, transforming personal demons into hard-won triumph with razor-sharp direction and unflinching force that critics hail as a theatrical hurricane.

vr.q: I just loved the show... I was in the story from the very beginning to the very end.
